title: Monomial basis of the symmetric algebra with arbitrary basis index set
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], let $V$ be a $k$-vector space, and let $(e_i)_{i\in I}$ be a basis, with $I$ any set. Write $\iota:V\to\operatorname{Sym}_k(V)$ for the canonical linear map into the symmetric algebra [lem-weil-pbc-symmetric-algebra-universal-property]. For each finitely supported function $m:I\to\mathbf N$, set $E^m=\prod_{i\in\operatorname{supp}(m)}\iota(e_i)^{m_i}$, with $E^0=1$. Then $(E^m)_{m\in\mathbf N^{(I)}}$ is a $k$-basis of $\operatorname{Sym}_k(V)$. This includes $I=\varnothing$.
